channel.title: Long Beach Press-Telegram - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Long Beach Press-Telegram (presstelegram.com)

item.title: Attorney says Gabbard is holding up a complaint about her actions, which her office denies
item.description: An attorney says Gabbard has delayed giving members of Congress a complaint about her conduct.

item.title: USC heads into 2026 season with a QB room that’s ‘quite a bit better’ than last year
item.description: General Manager Chad Bowden is confident the Trojans can retain incoming quarterback Jonas Williams, who complements Jayden Maiava.

item.title: Long Beach Catholic school vandalized, religious articles destroyed overnight
item.description: Long Beach police are searching for suspects in the case.

item.title: Owners of Brentwood home where Marilyn Monroe died sue LA, mayor
item.description: Husband and wife Roy Bank and Brinah Milstein, who live at the Brentwood property, contend that Los Angeles designated the house a historic monument "without any public purpose or just compensation," the suit says.

item.title: K-pop’s BTS announce a live comeback concert to air on Netflix in March
item.description: Following the livestreamed concert 'The Comeback Live | Arirang' on March 21, Netflix will premiere the new documentary 'BTS: The Return' on March 27.

item.title: LAFC GM John Thorrington says everyone is ‘buying in’ as new era begins
item.description: New head coach Marc Dos Santos and his staff have offered up ideas to tweak how LAFC will play, and it’s evident to Thorrington that the players have taken to them.

item.title: El Monte activist alleges ICE officers broke her car window, pointed weapons at her
item.description: Maria Santay, a U.S. citizen who watches for immigration operations, livestreams the encounter and alleges authorities tried to intimidate her.

item.title: Report: Clippers, James Harden exploring trade options; Cavaliers interested
item.description: A Sports Illustrated report says the team is in advanced talks with Cleveland to send the 11-time All-Star to the Cavaliers in exchange for Darius Garland. There could be other options between now and Thursday’s NBA trade deadline.

item.title: Clippers lose to 76ers amid James Harden trade talk
item.description: With rumors of a Harden deal swirling, Kawhi Leonard (29 points) and the Clippers fall behind by 23 in the first half and lose to Tyrese Maxey (29 points) and Philadelphia, 128-113.

item.title: Millikan boys basketball sinks Long Beach Poly with 3-pointers to win Moore League title
item.description: Millikan's hot shooting from beyond the 3-point arc carries it past Long Beach Poly in a victory that clinches the Moore League title.
